headline: 14 ECONOMIES.
NEW TARIFFS
PROPOSED.
hook: USTR proposed tariffs of 15% to 35% over industrial overcapacity. Vietnam drew the top rate.
Mexico, with a $196.9B U.S. goods deficit in 2025, was held back.
